subject: POC workshop & throughput benchmark — proposed kickoff windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greenbeta.com>, Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenbeta.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC workshop & throughput benchmark — proposed kickoff windows

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday. Per our discussion, we'd like to get a hands-on POC kickoff + an initial throughput/latency benchmark scheduled. High-level goals:
- Walk through prompt sets and routing rules (30–45m)
- Dry-run end-to-end harness on a small sample (30m)
- Full load run + profiling (1.5–3h depending on target)

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Wed 16 Sep, 10:00–14:00 (workshop + dry-run + load)
- Option B: Thu 17 Sep, 13:00–17:00 (workshop + dry-run; separate load on Fri)
- Option C: Mon 21 Sep, 09:00–13:00 (split across teams)

Please tell us which option works best, and who from your side will be the technical lead on the day. Also:
- Do you have a target throughput and latency SLO we should hit for the initial run? (examples: 200 req/s, p95 < 200ms)
- We'll send a short runbook and test harness link once we lock the slot — see attached v1 of the load plan.

Thanks — we'll get calendar invites out once you confirm.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-poc-load-plan-v1.pdf
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greenbeta.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenbeta.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC workshop & throughput benchmark — proposed kickoff windows

Karthik —

Thanks for the options. Quick note: our Director of Platform has a standing conflict on the 16th. Preference would be Option B (Thu 17 Sep) but we need the load run to happen on the same week (ideally Fri 18 Sep) because we have another blackout on Mon.

Target for the initial benchmark: aim for 180–220 req/s (our traffic profile is mostly short prompts ~80–120 tokens). Latency target we'd like to validate is p95 < 300ms and p99 < 600ms — we know p99 can spike but want a baseline.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide the test harness container or we run a client from our environment? Also, we need a short list of pre-reqs (IP allowlist, sample prompts, credentials).

Best,
Sarah Lim
Head of Platform | GreenBeta
sarah.lim@greenbeta.com

Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC workshop & throughput benchmark — proposed kickoff windows

On Tue, Sep 7, 2026 at 10:12 AM Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greenbeta.com> wrote:
> Karthik —
>
> Thanks for the options. Quick note: our Director of Platform has a standing conflict on the 16th. Preference would be Option B (Thu 17 Sep) but we need the load run to happen on the same week (ideally Fri 18 Sep) because we have another blackout on Mon.
>
> Target for the initial benchmark: aim for 180–220 req/s (our traffic profile is mostly short prompts ~80–120 tokens). Latency target we'd like to validate is p95 < 300ms and p99 < 600ms — we know p99 can spike but want a baseline.
>
> Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide the test harness container or we run a client from our environment? Also, we need a short list of pre-reqs (IP allowlist, sample prompts, credentials).

Thanks for the clarity, Sarah — that's helpful. Short answers:
- We'll host the harness and can either run the driver from our test runner inside your environment (recommended for realistic network hops) or provide a container that you run on-prem. We'll coordinate whichever you prefer.
- Pre-reqs: IP ranges (will send), a service account token for the harness, sample prompt set (please share any redaction rules), and an allowlist for our test runner IPs.

Plan proposal based on your ask:
- Thu 17 Sep 13:00–16:00 — Hands-on prompt routing & sample dry-run (workshop)
- Fri 18 Sep 10:00–15:00 — Full load run + tracing/profiling (we'll break the day into three 90m windows and iterate)

I'll attach a short runbook snippet and a link to the harness. Marissa will lead the run from our side and Connor will cover metrics collection. Can you confirm names from GreenBeta so I can send invites?

Karthik
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenbeta.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greenbeta.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC workshop & throughput benchmark — proposed kickoff windows

Karthik —

Thanks for the proposal. Confirming attendees from our side:
- Alex Porter (DevOps lead, will run the harness)
- Naomi Chen (SRE) — will join the load window only
- Priya Sethi (Product) — will join the workshop portion

Throughput/latency notes: we concur with the 180–220 req/s target. For SLOs, let's plan to validate p95 < 300ms; p99 < 600ms is tolerated during warmup but should stabilize. Also: our security team asked whether you have a SOC2 report and a short list of logs/retention for the run (we need to include in the procurement packet).

I can run the container from our k8s cluster; please share the image name and a minimal env var example. If possible, include a canned traffic profile we can replay for the dry-run.

—Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@greenbeta.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@greenbeta.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC workshop & throughput benchmark — proposed kickoff windows

Alex / team —

Looping in the runbook details. Notes below (snippet):
- Harness image: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/poc-harness:20260901
- Minimal env vars: REDWOOD_ENDPOINT, REDWOOD_TOKEN (we'll provide a short-lived test token), TARGET_RPS, PROMPT_SET_PATH
- Dry-run profile: 60s at 20rps with sample prompt_set_small.json (we'll push the sample to the Drive link)
- Full profile: staged ramp 0->TARGET_RPS (2m), steady for 20m segments, interleaved short/long prompt samples
- Telemetry: trace IDs, per-request timing (client send, network, server token gen, server decode), aggregated per-1s counters

I'm available to lead the workshop on Thu 17 Sep 13:00–16:00; Connor will own the Friday runs. I'll attach a small runbook extract (redwood-runbook-snippet.txt) and post the harness folder to the Drive link.

On SOC2: we have a current Type II report and can share an attestation PDF via our security portal. I'll ask our security contact to prepare a short log-retention summary (what logs we capture during a POC run and retention window).

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-runbook-snippet.txt

Marissa / team —

This all looks good. Quick scheduling update: our Product owner needs to move the workshop 1 hour earlier on Thu due to a calendar conflict — could we shift Thu to 12:00–15:00 PT and keep Fri 10:00–15:00 as-is? That would still give us the dry-run and a full day for load.

Also, for procurement: please send the SOC2 attestation link and a short SOW addendum outlining the proposed 2-day engagement so our finance team can start the DocuSign request. If you send the calendar invites and the Drive materials today, we'll accept and confirm.

Thanks,
Sarah
